title: Strategic enablers of digital transformation: a quantitative study on SMEs in Vietnam
core_idea: Investigate the key factors that influence digital transformation in Vietnamese SMEs and propose practical implications to enhance the effectiveness of their digital initiatives.
tldr: Survey-based quantitative study of 610 Vietnamese SMEs across 16 sectors using EFA, CFA, and multiple linear regression to analyze strategic enablers of digital transformation and offer recommendations for SME leaders and policymakers.
